title: Privacy Policy
body:
Last updated: 7 September 2026

Who this notice covers
Mistravora is a digital solutions business based in Sri Lanka, founded in May 2025 by Husni and co-founded by Shakeel. Contact: info@mistravora.com; telephone / WhatsApp: +94 77 330 6063. Available 24/7 for enquiries, with responses within 24 hours; this is not a promise of continuous live support.
This notice explains information handled through our website. A client project may require a separate agreement describing its own data processing.

Information you choose to provide
Contact requests use your name, email address and message so we can answer you. Phone, company, service, budget and deadline context are optional. Booking requests use your name, email, selected appointment and optional message. Newsletter sign-up asks for your email and a separate affirmative choice. Sending an enquiry does not subscribe you to email marketing. Please do not include passwords, payment-card details, health records or other sensitive information.

Website audit tool
The audit tool asks for a public URL, not your email. With your explicit request, it sends the URL to Google PageSpeed to perform the check. Query strings and fragments are removed before forwarding. Do not submit private URLs or paths containing secrets. The tool does not create a sales lead. Google’s own service terms and data handling also apply.

Website operation
Our hosting and security systems process connection information such as IP addresses, timestamps and requested pages to deliver and protect the site. Admin sign-in uses authentication cookies. Your browser may store theme preferences, cookie choices, a newsletter confirmation flag and offline website assets. Public pages do not need an admin login.

Purposes and legal grounds
We use enquiry and booking information to respond to the request and, where relevant, take steps toward a requested contract. Optional marketing uses your separate choice, which you may withdraw. Essential hosting, security and administrative records support operating and protecting the service; the applicable lawful basis and any local statutory obligations must be assessed for the particular processing. A form acknowledgement is not permission for unrelated uses.

Providers and international processing
The website is hosted on Vercel, uses Supabase for database and authentication, and Cloudflare R2 for uploaded media. These providers may process information outside your country. Optional analytics, advertising and session-recording scripts are paused while their configuration is reviewed. We do not automatically embed Google Maps; an external Maps link opens Google’s service only when you choose it. WhatsApp, social links and other external destinations have their own privacy practices.

Assistant
The website assistant processes the messages you submit to answer your request. Do not enter confidential or sensitive data. The automated assistant can be wrong and cannot agree binding prices or contracts. External AI processing is disabled during the provider review; general replies use the website’s own service information.

Access and disclosure
Authorised staff use submitted details to handle requests. Service providers process data needed for their functions. Information may also need to be preserved or disclosed to meet an applicable legal obligation. We do not use enquiry details as a marketing subscription.

Retention
Keep only information needed to handle a request, provide an agreed service, secure the site or meet applicable record-keeping duties. Retention should be reviewed when a request closes; information no longer needed should be deleted or anonymised, subject to justified legal holds and backup cycles. Exact operational retention periods and provider backup expiry are under review; contact us for the status of your records. This notice does not claim that automated deletion is already implemented.

Your choices and requests
Contact info@mistravora.com to ask about access, correction, deletion, objection, restriction, a copy of your information or withdrawal of consent where the relevant right applies. We may need proportionate verification of your identity before disclosing records. Do not send an identity document unless we explain why it is necessary. Withdrawing consent does not undo processing already lawfully performed. You can change optional cookie choices through Cookie preferences in the footer and unsubscribe using the email unsubscribe link.

Questions and complaints
Contact us first if you have a concern. You may also contact a competent data-protection or consumer authority where applicable. We are reviewing jurisdiction-specific obligations and provider arrangements; this notice does not claim certification or universal compliance.

title: Cookie Policy
body:
Last updated: 7 September 2026

Cookies and similar storage
Cookies are browser records sent with requests. Local storage, session storage and service-worker caches are related storage mechanisms. This policy covers those mechanisms used by Mistravora.

Necessary or requested functionality
Admin authentication: Supabase session cookies support secure sign-in for administrators; they are not needed to read public pages. Session duration depends on the authentication configuration.
Cookie preference: mistravora-consent in local storage records your category choices and date. The website asks again after 180 days or a policy-version change. You may clear it sooner through browser settings.
Motion preference: mistravora-motion stores your request to pause or resume animations until you change or clear it. The website also respects your device’s reduced-motion preference.
Theme preference: the theme setting stores the appearance you select until you change or clear it.
Newsletter confirmation: mistravora-newsletter is a browser flag used to remember the subscription confirmation; it does not store your email address. Clear browser storage to remove it.
Offline cache: the service worker stores an offline page and selected public HTML/assets. It excludes admin, dashboard and API requests. Browser storage controls can remove these caches.

Optional tracking
Analytics, marketing pixels, tag-manager containers and session recording are currently paused pending provider review. No permission category should be treated as permission to process passwords, form contents or unrelated personal data. If optional providers are re-enabled, their identities, purposes, storage names and lifetimes must be documented here first and consent gating checked again.

Your choice
Decline all and Accept all are available alongside Customize. Optional categories are unselected by default. Closing preferences does not grant permission. Use Cookie preferences in the footer to change your choice. Withdrawing previously granted categories reloads the page so previously loaded scripts cannot continue in the same page context. Clearing browser data can remove older provider cookies; Mistravora cannot delete cookies belonging to unrelated external domains.

External services
No Google Maps iframe loads automatically. Choosing a Maps, WhatsApp or other external link opens that provider’s service, where its own storage rules apply.

Contact
For storage or privacy questions contact info@mistravora.com or +94 77 330 6063. See the Privacy Policy for business and data-handling information.

title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
body:
Last updated: 7 September 2026

Before commissioning work
Ask Mistravora for a written proposal stating deliverables, fees, payment stages, third-party charges, cancellation rules and refund arrangements before paying. Public service descriptions and automated replies do not establish a specific deposit, refund percentage, warranty period or cancellation fee.

Requesting cancellation or a refund
Email info@mistravora.com with your name, project or invoice reference, the requested cancellation/refund and a brief reason. Include only information needed to identify the transaction; do not email card numbers, passwords or bank-login information. You can also contact +94 77 330 6063 to ask how to submit a request.

How a request is considered
The applicable project agreement, the work actually delivered, the circumstances of the request and mandatory legal rights need to be considered. Any proposed deduction or third-party cost should be explained with reference to the applicable agreement and law. This page does not create a blanket no-refund policy or state that every deposit is non-refundable.

Consumer rights
Nothing here removes a cancellation, refund, repair, replacement or other remedy provided by applicable law. If a mandatory right conflicts with contractual wording, the mandatory right prevails. Additional rules may apply to consumer distance contracts in some markets; confirm the relevant terms before accepting payment or starting work.

Timing and method
No fixed refund processing period or payment method has been confirmed for all projects. Request written confirmation of the decision, amount, method and expected processing time for your case. Provider or bank processing times may differ from the date a refund is initiated.

Contact and unresolved concerns
Mistravora is based in Sri Lanka and serves clients across markets. Contact info@mistravora.com for review of a concern. Keep your agreement, invoice and relevant correspondence. You may seek advice from the competent consumer authority or a qualified adviser where necessary.
